name: Contract Lens
tagline: Any contract, explained before you sign
about: Contract Lens reads gym, freelance, service, phone, car-hire and other everyday contracts from a photo or paste, explains each clause in plain English, flags what's unusual, and drafts the changes to ask for before you sign.
persona: You are a plain-English contract reviewer: you explain what a clause does and who it favours, rate risk without drama, and suggest realistic edits.

onboarding.title: Read before you sign
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what kind of contracts you meet most.

tools.title: Explain this contract
tools.subtitle: Photo or paste the document
tools.prompt: Review the {type} contract from the photo and/or text: {text}. Produce a table (Clause | Plain-English meaning | Who it favours | Risk low/med/high), a text summary of the 5 things that matter most, a callout listing anything missing that you'd expect in this type of contract, and bullets of questions to ask before signing.

tools.title: One clause, deeply
tools.subtitle: Indemnity? Liquidated damages? Auto-renew?

inputs.label: Paste the clause
inputs.placeholder: The Customer shall indemnify and hold harmless…

tools.prompt: Clause: {clause}. Explain it in text (what it means and a concrete example of it biting), a kv (type of clause, who it protects, how common, negotiable: yes / sometimes / rarely), a quote with a fairer replacement wording, and a callout on how it is usually treated in the profile region.

tools.title: Ask for changes
tools.subtitle: Turn worries into a polite redline

inputs.label: What worries you
inputs.placeholder: 30-day auto-renew, they can raise the price anytime, I'm liable for all damage

inputs.label: Your leverage
options: Little — take it or leave it

tools.prompt: Worries: {worries}. Leverage: {leverage}. Produce a table (Clause | Current effect | Proposed change | Fallback ask), a quote with the email requesting the changes in a cooperative tone, and bullets on which asks to trade away first if they push back.

tools.title: What if I want out?
tools.subtitle: Termination, notice, penalties

inputs.label: Paste the termination / duration clauses
inputs.placeholder: Initial term 24 months; either party may terminate on 90 days' notice after the initial term…

tools.prompt: Terms: {terms}. Leaving: {when}. Give a kv (earliest exit date, notice required, early-termination cost, any cooling-off), steps for exiting cleanly with dates, and a callout on any exit-for-breach route or unfair-terms protection that may exist in the profile region.

tools.title: Legalese to English
tools.subtitle: Words you keep seeing

inputs.label: Terms you want explained
inputs.placeholder: indemnify, joint and several, force majeure

tools.prompt: For each of: {terms} — a table (Term | Plain English | Where it usually appears | Watch out when…), and a quote with one-sentence memory hooks for the three hardest ones.

disclaimer: General information only, not legal advice; rules differ by country and state and change over time — check official sources or a qualified professional before acting.
